sections.title: Usage
sections.body: Vite plugin configuration. directory defaults to src/routes. clientRoutes and serverRoutes switch to explicit manual tables and must be supplied together. Paths are resolved relative to the Vite project root.

sections.title: Application data endpoint
sections.body: dataEndpoint defaults to /_smolter. On a shared origin, configure an app-specific path consistently in the browser routes, Vite middleware and production HTTP adapter. The asset/CDN base is independent.
